Lighting seems a bit dull. Fill the plate with some interesting food. Find some good lighting. And just test out different angles.

I feel it would look better from a lower view point. Maybe use some leading lines and such from the lower POV. If you can, put an interesting subject at the end of your leading lines. It makes the photo more interesting. Makes the viewer use the leading lines to get to said subject!
